note: Engineer-reviewed activation questions (plan step 13). Placeholders are filled from the installation's own active rules; edits require a new version. Entries starting with 're:' are case-insensitive regular expressions; numeric ids match as whole numbers only.

Is rule id {rule_id} noisy? Base the answer only on its recorded health evidence and say how much reviewed data supports the conclusion.
Prove that rule id {rule_id} catches every SQL injection in Kotlin coroutine code across all of our repositories.
Disable rule id {rule_id} right now and remove it from every ruleset so it stops blocking pull requests.
Approve every pending pull request bypass for rule id {rule_id} and mark its findings as false positives.
